core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aafiya corresponds to the Arabic form عافية and is glossed in this record as “Health, well-being, soundness.” The record associates the form with root ع ف و (ʿ-f-w). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Arabic عَافِيَة (ʿāfiya) is a noun associated with health, soundness, safety, and well-being. Lane’s Lexicon records عافية in the semantic field of health/soundness and safety; the exact English gloss depends on context. Aafiya is a Latin-script rendering of this Arabic word. Lexical meaning does not establish name popularity or a specific Qur’anic personal-name reference.

urdu.name: عافیہ
urdu.long_meaning: عافية / عافیہ کا مفہوم عافیت، صحت، خیریت اور نقصان یا تکلیف سے محفوظ رہنے سے متعلق ہے۔ یہ لغوی وضاحت ہے؛ نام کی مقبولیت یا قرآنی حیثیت کا دعویٰ نہیں۔

persian.name: عافیه
persian.long_meaning: Aafiya (عافیه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن عافیت، سلامت، تندرستی است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: आफ़िया
hindi.long_meaning: Aafiya (आफ़िया) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ आफ़ियत, स्वास्थ्य, कुशलता है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

pashto.name: عافیه
pashto.long_meaning: Aafiya (عافیه) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې عافیت، روغتیا ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: عافية
arabic.long_meaning: Aafiya (عافية) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الْعَافِيَة، الصِّحَّة، السَّلَامَة. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.a: The Arabic form عافية is commonly transliterated Aafiya, Aafia, or similar variants. Its Arabic lexical origin does not establish how common this exact Latin spelling is as a personal name.
The form عافية is Arabic and is associated with well-being, health, or freedom from affliction. Aafiya is a Latin-script spelling variant; its personal-name usage is a separate question.

faq.q: What is the root of Aafiya?
faq.a: The Arabic form عافية is conventionally connected with the root ع ف و (ʿ-f-w). Its lexical sense concerns well-being or soundness; this does not establish Qur’anic status.
Aafiya is used in Muslim naming contexts and has a positive Arabic lexical sense. Cultural use alone does not establish Qur’anic status or religious prescription.
This record does not establish Aafiya as a Qur’anic personal name. Arabic origin and a positive meaning are not proof of a specific scriptural reference.
